name: Maximilian Roedel
headline: Co-Founder @ Vantis GmbH | ex-Amazon | CDTM
summary:
I’m co-founder at Vantis, working on one problem: how to deliver better primary care for people with chronic conditions. Before Vantis, I built and led teams at Amazon, Swarovski and in consulting – always at the intersection of data, operations and products.

Over time, three principles have emerged for me
-	Long-term owner: I care about long-term impact, not short-term wins. I am comfortable making tough calls in light of the long-term vision.
-	Learning machine: I hold myself accountable, and let facts and feedback win over ego. This raises the bar for my product, the team and myself.
-	Fast, but not loose: I ship fast when we need speed, and I’m uncompromising on quality where safety, regulation or trust are on the line. 

Outside of work, I apply the same mindset. Alpine rock climbing and freediving are my ways to explore limits: deliberate preparation, clear decisions under pressure, and constant learning from small mistakes before they become big ones. This keeps me grounded.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Vantis is a technology driven primary care provider with focus on patients with chronic diseases. Check it out: https://vantis-praxis.de

positions.title: Automated Inventory Management
positions.description: Pioneered the automation of inventory management through big data for Amazon in EU (>30 business lines, >10mn SKUs per country, >10bn USD inventory). Defined a routine to manage product availability and root-cause every out of stock website click automatically. Operated product availability across >100 departments and in peak time on a daily cadence. Led an initiative to improve product availability for US, EU, JP and new markets worth >1bn USD bottom line improvement.

positions.title: Head of panEU Apparel SCM
positions.description: Redesigned Amazon’s approach for buying long lead time, seasonal items to optimize for total season performance. Scaled the new planning approach from EU Apparel to EU Shoes. Together with several reporting/ system/ supply chain improvements, this improved the healthy of inventory lifting margins by x00bps while improving out of stock by 20%. Established a new panEU team spanning across country silos.

positions.title: Head of Demand & Inventory
positions.description: Established an S&OP routine to transform an overproduction culture into a lean inventory culture. Upgraded inventory systems, particularly forecasting, the target inventory model, and a multi-echelon model for semi-finished products. This reduced inventory value by 39% at the same product availability. Rebuilt the team and coached it to high performance.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Project manager of teams with three consultants and up to ten clients mostly in Central and Eastern Europe. Specialized in
- Growth strategies, e.g. global market assessment for an equipment manufacturer including market sizing, customer segmentation, market assessment, market entry strategy and M&A strategy; designing and launching several convergence products in the telecommunications industry
- Optimization, e.g. green-field development of a postal last mile delivery from designing postal addresses to defining the operations strategy; optimizing customer management in the telecommunications industry
- Private equity: various market side due diligence

company.name: Vantis
company.tagline: Digitale Behandlungsmethoden mit persönlicher ärztlicher Betreuung vor Ort.
company.description:
Bei Vantis stehen wir an vorderster Front der medizinischen Innovation. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Technologie und chronischen Krankheiten arbeiten wir daran, die traditionelle Gesundheitsversorgung radikal zu verbessern.

Wie machen wir das? Durch die Kombination digitaler Behandlungswege und einer maßgeschneiderten, patientenzentrierten Versorgung vor Ort.
